AuthorDetails.Description: As a proud Certified B Corporation®, we are passionate about amplifying the voices and visions of purpose-driven start-ups, SMEs, not-for-profits, and global enterprises.

Description: A discussion forum that runs inside your Umbraco 17 site, with moderation built in. Boards are Umbraco content, while threads and posts live in their own tables, so a busy forum doesn't fill your content tree. Moderators can work on the website itself, without backoffice accounts. Free to use.

Screenshots.Caption: The forum front-end: boards grouped by category, server-rendered and fully crawlable
The front-end moderation queue: members of the Moderators group approve, remove and dismiss from inside the community, with no backoffice account
A thread with replies, avatars and tags
Polls on a thread: one vote per member with live results
A Q&A board with Latest / Newest / Unanswered / Top sorting
The unified Community moderation queue: approve, remove or dismiss forum posts and page comments in one list

RelatedPackages.Description: Comments for any Umbraco page, moderated from the same queue
